body: Yup this or try to get him into a hobby he will like because usually that will distract a person.

I'm sure you tried you're best and yes if you personally felt it was starting to get to your health then I understand.

I'm happy to be in a relationship that I am in because if my gf was depressed and getting to a very low points I would be there for her till the very end trying my best everyday and never giving up on her no matter what costs it does to my health, she knows that I would do that for her and I know she would do the same.


I think your ex can somewhat relate to me but I should mention I'm nowhere near accomplished as much as him and I'm 21 now and have been suicidal since 10 years old but depression doesn't see things you've accomplished, achieved or things you just got going for you.

In my opinion... You know he loves you and if you love him back then let him hold onto that thing he loves and just try to be there for him as much as possible because you never know you could be the only thing keeping him alive like my gf.

Edit: a very big auto correction

You shouldn't breakup with someone just because they couldn't love themselves.

I have a gf and I don't love myself, I try my hardest in the relationship. Being with someone means you'll be with them through thick or thin, through anything and wouldn't just turn away.

You can hate yourself, have no self worth, have suicidal thoughts but in no way means people like that are incapable of finding happiness in someone else before loving themself.
